responsibility: Hooks the outlives inference queries into typeck, computes the crate-wide map of inferred predicates from explicit and implicit sources, converts the internal predicate sets into query results, and serves per-item inferred outlives data including `rustc_outlives` diagnostic output for annotated items.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is centered on inferred outlives query computation and per-item retrieval of inferred predicates, including test-attribute-triggered reporting, rather than general checking, conversion, or variance inference.
